checks: Three age levels; sound off by default; language switches and persists
Explorer starts with one mining target, nickname text and no countdown
Resource explanations and the question-mark help are visible before mining
Help works over a live choice without dismissing the question
Wrong choice reduces survival and explains retry without advancing
Leaving after a rewarded answer preserves its card and prevents duplicate rewards
Exit during construction keeps one paid building without losing materials twice
Explorer first mission reaches its learning summary through real mining, dust, battery and night choices
Reloading a completed summary does not grant a duplicate badge
All four Explorer missions complete, including processing, food, shelter, meteorites and the final building
The fourth mission has an explicit finish action that records campaign success and returns to the menu
Zero survival shows failure; Quit returns to menu; Try again preserves buildings, resources and learned cards
Engineer and Commander initialize with their own saved level and age settings
Seeded free-play fixture buys a drill, selects an unlocked ridge, breaks a tougher rock in two taps and banks its five-rock yield
Desktop viewport bounds and offline Chinese font loading pass
Malformed saved mission safely falls back to a fresh game
